Bonn Challenge Land Restoration Pledge Through 2030Kazakhstan pledged to restore up to 1.5 million hectares of degraded land through afforestation and reforestation by 2030, with planting programmes intended to support rehabilitation, forestry jobs, and carbon sequestration.Commitment+1 point1 document1 quote

The government pledged to restore up to 1.5 million ha of degraded land through afforestation and reforestation by 2030 under the Bonn Challenge. Planting programmes are intended to support land rehabilitation, convert unproductive land to forestry, rejuvenate damaged landscapes, and create forestry and timber-industry jobs; the pledge is described as bringing mitigation benefits and increasing carbon sequestration.
